openQuestions.text: Which application platform(s) must support this feature?
Which user roles are allowed to archive ideas?
Which user roles are allowed to restore archived ideas?
Which user roles are allowed to perform merge actions?
How are "multiple and similar ideas" identified for merge purposes?
Is similarity determined by users, by system logic, or both?
What UI surfaces expose archive, restore, and merge actions?
How are archived ideas displayed or identified to users?
Can users browse or filter archived ideas?
Are confirmation steps required before archive, restore, or merge?
Is an API required for archive, restore, and merge operations?
If APIs are required, what are the endpoint, method, request, response, and error contracts?
How is archived state represented in the data model?
Must the system record merge relationships between the kept idea and archived ideas?
Must the system record who archived or restored an idea and when?
Are there any conditions under which an archived idea cannot be restored?
What state does an idea return to after restore?
Are archived ideas retained indefinitely, or is there any retention/purge policy?
Are there accessibility or copy standards for the UI supporting this feature?
Are there any non-functional requirements for performance, security, reliability, or observability?
